learning_outcomes.text: Learning exergy, chemical exergy, exergy efficiency and entropy.
Ability to use exergy analysis techniques in engineering applications.
Ability to analyze the exergy of a system.
Ability to independently apply exergy analysis.
Ability to develop oneself by following technological advancements and to communicate in writing.

syllabus_topics: Energy analysis in closed systems and cycles
Mass and energy conservation in control volume
Entropy balance in closed systems and control volume
Thermodynamic analysis of steady-state flow processes
Exergy analysis in closed and flow systems in control volume
bibliography: Moran, M.J. and Shapiro, H.N. “Fundamentals of Engineering Thermodynamics”, John Wiley, 4.Edition, 2000 (Chapters 2-7).
Bejan,A., Tsatsaronis,G., Moran,M., “Thermal Design and Optimization”, John Wiley and Sons, Inc.,New York,1996.
